description: This Python source file defines a test case class 'BuildTests' to verify that BitBake can build 'virtual/libc' inside the build tools environment. It imports necessary modules, sets up a temporary build directory, initializes the build environment, modifies configuration, runs the build command, and performs cleanup/waiting for lock files.
